use_drop_path: use the drop_path function to apply stochastic depth dropout to a tensor during training
create_DropPath_module: create a DropPath module to apply stochastic depth dropout per sample in residual blocks
create_GraphDropPath_module: create a GraphDropPath module to apply stochastic depth dropout considering batch for graph data
create_EquivariantDropout_module: create an EquivariantDropout module to apply equivariant dropout using e3nn irreps and elementwise tensor product
create_EquivariantScalarsDropout_module: create an EquivariantScalarsDropout module to apply dropout only to scalar irreps in equivariant tensors
